header: Two small, pure helpers shared by circular search. No DB, no model, no state.

1. contentTokens(): the words of a query that actually carry meaning. The lexical scoring in api/ai-search/route.ts used to count EVERY word longer than 2 letters, including "what", "the", "for", "how", "does". Almost any chunk contains two of those, so almost every chunk looked like a "perfect lexical match" (82-93%) whatever the topic. I count only content words now, so the lexical signal means something.

2. isHolidayTopic(): does the question concern holidays / leave-day rules? I want the holiday-list circulars (no body text, found by headline embedding) and the holiday-policy notes to compete in the results ONLY for such questions. For every other question they were pure filler (50-89% on unrelated queries, in 30 of 46 battery questions).

symbols.name: contentTokens
doc: Returns the meaningful words of a query (lower-case, edge punctuation removed, stopwords dropped, length > 2).

symbols.name: AUDIENCE_WORDS
doc: Words that name WHO a circular is for (or the organisation), not WHAT it is about.

symbols.name: topicTokens
doc: Returns the words of a query that say WHAT it is about: the content words minus audience and organisation words.
